# Accolad

> > Accolad is a French-Canadian employee recognition platform offering digital gift cards, corporate rewards, and automated gifting solutions for businesses across Canada and the US.

Accolad specializes in employee recognition and engagement through a curated marketplace of 150+ gift card options from major Canadian, US, and local retailers. The platform supports service anniversary programs, special occasion gifting, and self-service recognition workflows for HR teams.

## Key Topics

- Employee Recognition
- Digital Gift Cards
- Corporate Rewards
- Service Anniversaries
- Employee Engagement
- Gift Card Marketplace
- HR Platform
- Automated Gifting
- Employee Appreciation
- French-Canadian
- Self-Service Recognition
- Retail Partners (Amazon, Walmart, Sephora, Best Buy, Lululemon)
- Service Recognition Program
- Corporate Gifts
- Canada & US Coverage

## Core Recognition Programs

- [Plateforme de Reconnaissance des Employés - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com): Accolad employee recognition platform with digital gift cards and corporate rewards
- [Programme de reconnaissance des années de service - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/pages/reconnaissance-des-annees-de-service): Service anniversary recognition program with automated gifting and employee appreciation
- [Cadeaux d'entreprise pour toutes les occasions - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/pages/cadeaux-occasions-speciales): Corporate gifts for special occasions: retirement, departures, life celebrations
- [Cadeaux de reconnaissance libre-service - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/pages/libre-service-cadeaux-entreprise-personnalises): Self-service personalized digital gift cards for instant employee recognition

## Gift Card Catalog & Marketplace

- [Catalogue cadeaux de reconnaissance - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/pages/catalogue-de-recompenses): 150+ Canadian, US and local gift cards for corporate rewards and recognition
- [Catalogue cadeaux de reconnaissance - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/collections/catalogue-cartes-cadeaux-accolad): Comprehensive gift card catalog with 150+ Canadian, US and local options
- [Boutique de cartes-cadeaux pour entreprises - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/collections/recompenses): Gift card store with Indigo, Lululemon, Golf Town and major retail brands
- [Cadeaux pour employés, offrez des récompenses uniques! - Accolad](https://www.accolad.com/collections/cadeaux-pour-employes): Employee gift collection with Amazon, Walmart, TJX and universal gift cards
